title: Count visits from page hits
statement:
Table: `hits(user_id INTEGER, ts INTEGER)`, timestamps in seconds, in any order; the same user and timestamp may appear more than once.

A visit is a maximal run of one user's hits, in time order, in which every hit comes at most 1800 seconds after the previous one. For each user with at least one hit, return the user id, the number of visits, and the length of the longest visit in seconds (its last timestamp minus its first; a visit of one hit has length 0). Columns, in order: `user_id`, `visits`, `longest`. Rows ordered by `user_id`.

args:
CREATE TABLE hits (user_id INTEGER, ts INTEGER);
INSERT INTO hits VALUES (1, 100), (1, 1900), (1, 3701), (2, 50), (1, 3701), (2, 50);
